{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Sleeveless midi slip dress with a draped bodice, flowing silhouette, length hitting mid-calf, color #2E5C8A deep ocean blue, lightweight silk crepe.
Strappy nude satin sandals with a 4 cm stiletto heel.
Gold drop earrings and a delicate diamond-accented pendant necklace.
This outfit works because the rich ocean blue hue stands out elegantly against typical white or cream wedding guest attire while remaining respectful to the formal dress code. The silk crepe fabric drapes fluidly in the warm August evening air, ensuring comfort during the outdoor ceremony before transitioning seamlessly to the restaurant dinner. The minimalist cut allows the bold color and your confident presence to naturally capture attention without appearing overly flashy or disrespectful."}
